model_annotation: This figure presents three donut charts comparing industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021. The charts are divided into four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services. In the first chart, industry accounts for 8 percent, construction accounts for 61 percent, trade accounts for 19 percent, and other services accounts for 19 percent. The second chart has industry at 21 percent, construction at 51 percent, trade at 19 percent, and other services at 9 percent. The third chart shows industry at 33 percent, construction at 6 percent, trade at 31 percent, and other services at 31 percent. Each chart includes a legend listing the colors that correspond with the sectors. The second chart has a sector visually distinguished from the others through bold black text. The sectors appear to be ordered by size in descending order in the first and second charts.
